Here are some prominent law firms in Brisbane that specialize in medical negligence and malpractice compensation claims:

  
[Oak Medical Law](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVhkak1HWXlNR1pmGAo) 

  
Specialist health law firm providing **direct-to-director guidance** and recognized as a leading Queensland compensation practice with an exclusive focus on representing injured patients rather than insurers.[[1]](https://oakmedical.com.au/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVhkak1HWXlNR1pmGAo)

Dedicated **medico-legal representation** helping clients navigate complex compensation claims with a supportive, results-driven approach.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSGxIZCgNwdnESEkNnc3ZaeTh4ZUdjMWMzWnRlURgK)  
[Smith's Lawyers Brisbane](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSGxIZCgNwdnESEkNnc3ZaeTh4ZEdkdE16QnNOQRgK) 

  
Offers a risk-free **No Win, No Fee, No Catch** promise covering associated legal costs and outlays even if a case is unsuccessful.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSGxIZCgNwdnESEkNnc3ZaeTh4ZEdkdE16QnNOQRgK)Show more

In Queensland, strict pre-court procedures apply to medical liability claims , and there is generally a **3-year time limit** from the date of the incident or discovery of the injury to bring a claim to court. Most specialized firms offer a free initial case evaluation.[[1]](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/medical-injury/medical-negligence-lawyers-brisbane/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdSNWJuWnVkalJ3GAo)[[3]](https://oakmedical.com.au/)[[4]](https://www.gainlawyers.com.au/medical-negligence/brisbane)
